about_the_game:
This is the demo for Theralite, our turn-based Sci-fi Roguelike.

It contains most of the mechanics we want to have in our game but it is not yet completely balanced and definitely does not contain all of the content.

You can play the first biome of the game and try to win against the first boss at the bottom of the mines - good luck with that!

We want to get your player feedback regarding "game flow", difficulty, controls and so on.
